label: Research protocol - not approved for routine clinical use
owner: Local dialysis unit must replace this research configuration

urgent.reason: The clinician has flagged immediate concern.
Current observed SBP is below 90 mmHg.
Symptoms are present with SBP below 100 mmHg.

review.reason: SBP has fallen at least 20 mmHg from the session baseline and is at or below 110 mmHg.

steps.title: Assess the patient at the chair
steps.instruction: Look at the patient, check consciousness and reported symptoms, and note position. Follow the local emergency pathway immediately for unresponsiveness or another red flag.

steps.title: Repeat and verify blood pressure
steps.instruction: Repeat the measurement using the unit's routine technique. Record cuff size, arm position, and whether the reading is observed or interpolated.

steps.title: Screen for red flags and alternative causes
steps.instruction: Use the locally approved protocol to check for bleeding, chest pain, syncope, hypoglycaemia, and other causes requiring separate escalation. Do not attribute every fall in BP to ultrafiltration.

steps.title: Review the UF state
steps.instruction: Review the current UF goal, volume removed, remaining volume, and rate against the locally approved protocol. Only authorized roles may change machine settings.

steps.title: Review locally authorized fluid options
steps.instruction: If the unit has an approved standing order, review the permitted fluid options and required confirmation. This console supplies no default dose and no patient-specific fluid recommendation.

steps.title: Recheck, document, and plan the next review
steps.instruction: Recheck per the locally approved protocol, record the action and response, and schedule the next cuff. Add any carry-forward fluid to the next-session review rather than silently changing a prescription.
